source: import Mathlib.Algebra.BigOperators.Group.Finset.Basic import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Basic import Mathlib.Tactic.Linarith set_option autoImplicit false namespace PV_L2B_Guards -- Mathematical guard laws. Native builder/canonicality/refinement association -- is retained, never represented by an additional trust item. def firstFailure : List Bool → Nat | [] => 0 | true :: _ => 1 | false :: xs => 1+firstFailure xs theorem passing_trace (n : Nat) : firstFailure (List.replicate n false) = n := by induction n with | zero => rfl | succ n ih => simp [List.replicate_succ,firstFailure,ih]; omega #print axioms passing_trace theorem failed_trace (xs : List Bool) : firstFailure (true::xs) = 1 := rfl #print axioms failed_trace theorem zero_guard {A : Type} [Zero A] [DecidableEq A] (x : A) (hx : x=0) : decide (x ≠ 0) = false := by simp [hx] #print axioms zero_guard theorem equality_guard {A : Type} [DecidableEq A] (x y : A) (h : x=y) : decide (x ≠ y) = false := by simp [h] #print axioms equality_guard theorem active_zero_guard {A : Type} [Zero A] [DecidableEq A] (active : Bool) (x : A) (h : active=true → x=0) : (active && decide (x ≠ 0)) = false := by cases active <;> simp_all #print axioms active_zero_guard theorem canonical_guard (p x : Nat) (hx : x simp [ha] | true => simp [ha,hz i ha] exact h.trans hs #print axioms padding_total theorem padding_preserves_sum {I A : Type} [Fintype I] [AddCommGroup A] (helper padding : I → A) (hh : (∑ i : I, helper i)=0) (hp : (∑ i : I, padding i)=0) : (∑ i : I, (helper i + padding i))=0 := by rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib,hh,hp,add_zero] #print axioms padding_preserves_sum end PV_L2B_Guards
